name: Samurai Oyako to Haramase Dousei Seikatsu ~Ama Ero Mama to Tsun Ubu Musume Docchi to Kozukuri!?~
original_name: サムライ母娘と孕ませ同棲生活～甘エロママとツン初心娘どっちと子作り!?～
source:
The protagonist met, by decree of his father, the elegantly beautiful Izumi and her spunky and equally beautiful daughter Rei.
By law, it seemed he would make a baby with both women!
Thus began his complex life of sexual thrills, at the same time making love with a woman who guided her daughter's hand, and together explored a threesome of depraved heaven! 

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE071172.html]DLsite English[/url]]
